Bill.BriefDescription: Protecting the rights of foster parents.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to foster parents' rights; and adding new sectionsto chapter 74.13 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.13 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: No department employee may retaliate against a foster parent or inany other manner discriminate against any foster parent because: (1) The foster parent made a complaint with the office of familyand children's ombudsman, the attorney general, law enforcementagencies, or the department, provided information, or otherwisecooperated with the investigation of such a complaint; (2) The foster parent has caused to be instituted any proceedingsunder or related to Title 13 RCW; (3) The foster parent has testified or is about to testify in anyproceedings under or related to Title 13 RCW; (4) The foster parent has advocated for services on behalf of thefoster child; (5) The foster parent has sought to adopt a foster child in thefoster parent's care; or p. 1 SHB 2988 (6) The foster parent has discussed or consulted with anyoneconcerning the foster parent's rights under this chapter or chapter74.15 or 13.34 RCW.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 74.13 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department shall develop procedures for the following: (a) Reporting a violation of section 1 of this act; (b) Disciplinary action in response to a violation of section 1 ofthis act; (c) Informing a foster parent who reports a violation of section 1of this act and the regional foster parent liaison of the outcome ofthe report; and (d) Informing foster parents of the provisions of section 1 of thisact and the procedures developed in accordance with this subsection. (2) The department shall report to the appropriate committees ofthe legislature on the procedures developed in accordance withsubsection 1 of this section by January 1, 2005.
